item.title: Michigan synagogue attacker was inspired by Hezbollah, sought to kill as many Jewish people as possible: feds
item.summary: Federal investigators say the Michigan synagogue attacker was radicalized by Hezbollah and reportedly sought to kill as many Jewish people as possible on March 12.

item.title: Rep Rashida Tlaib moves to block US operations in Lebanon but ignores Hezbollah
item.summary: Rep. Rashida Tlaib introduced a resolution to block U.S. support for Israeli military operations in Lebanon without congressional approval.

item.title: Kid Rock sparks US Army investigation after military helicopters stunt at Tennessee estate
item.summary: Kid Rock shared a video of AH-64 Apache helicopters hovering near his Nashville mansion, which prompted Fort Campbell to launch a formal investigation.

item.title: Former 'Dancing with the Stars' pro speaks out after surviving the deadly Air Canada LaGuardia crash
item.summary: Former "DWTS" pro Charlotte Jørgensen says she survived the deadly Air Canada LaGuardia runway collision, honoring the pilots who made the ultimate sacrifice.

item.title: 'Live with Kelly and Mark' EP reacts to Howie Mandel's apology video as other stars chime in
item.summary: Michael Gelman and celebrities like Terry Crews clap back at Howie Mandel with witty age jokes after his public apology to Kelly Ripa went viral.

item.title: Video shows police drone track down madman after alleged rampage with stabbing, shooting, crash into store
item.summary: Las Vegas police released drone video showing officers tracking a violent suspect after a domestic incident involving an alleged vehicle ramming and stabbing.

item.title: Illinois city denied motion to dismiss lawsuit against reparations program
item.summary: Judicial Watch's civil rights lawsuit against Evanston's reparations program moves forward after a federal judge rejected the city's dismissal bid over its race-based $25,000 payments.

item.title: DHS slams California 'sanctuary' county after mom allegedly murdered by 2 Honduran nationals
item.summary: Department of Homeland Security slams Santa Clara County for ignoring ICE detainers after two Honduran nationals allegedly murdered a 24-year-old mother under California's sanctuary law.

item.title: Jayapal floats reparations for illegal immigrants impacted by Trump crackdown, demands prosecutions
item.summary: Rep. Pramila Jayapal called for reparations for illegal immigrants amid Trump's crackdown, and said those enforcing immigration law should be prosecuted.

item.title: Bulls waive Jaden Ivey after he called NBA's Pride Month celebration 'unrighteousness'
item.summary: The Chicago Bulls waived Jaden Ivey after he called the NBA's Pride Month celebration "unrighteousness" in videos the team deemed conduct detrimental to the team.
